question: The interface vocabulary has no token for a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Which term should compute records use for an MCP-only interface, and should Groundbox, SUFY Sandbox, Ventaw, Oblien and box by Simular carry it in interface[]?
why: These hosted sandboxes are driven over MCP or REST; the nearest available terms rest, cli and browser lose the MCP qualifier, which is named in interface_detail instead. A rules session needs to add the term before these records can use it.
